summary: Two missing children (ages 14 and 7) searched for after getting off at the wrong RTD bus stop in Cherry Creek; found unharmed later that evening
location: Cherry Creek to Highlands Ranch; found on RTD light rail platform, 7500 Platte River Pkwy, Littleton
responding_agency: Douglas County Sheriff's Office; Douglas County Search and Rescue; Arapahoe County Search and Rescue; Littleton Police Department
notes: Jeremy Liebe (14) and Jameson Hall (7) were put on an RTD bus by their grandmother in Cherry Creek, were supposed to arrive in Highlands Ranch for pickup by their father, but got off at the wrong stop with no cell phones; DCSAR and Arapahoe County SAR dispatched; Littleton PD located them unharmed on the light-rail platform at 8:48 p.m.
